Little Bear Girl grew up and became a mom too.

One day, Little Bear Mom carried her baby, Little Bear Brother, while shopping. Raindrops began to fall from the sky. Little Bear Mom opened her lovely little umbrella, and they listened together as the raindrops sang and danced on the umbrella.

To keep Little Bear Brother from getting wet, to keep

the raindrops from soaking his clothes and his new soccer ball, Little Bear Mom always tilted the umbrella toward Little Bear Brother.

The sky cleared, and Little Bear Mom put away the umbrella.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《奇怪的雨伞》及其拼音。
[P2] 熊妈妈和小熊姑娘出门遇雨，妈妈撑伞并总是偏向女儿，雨停后女儿发现没淋湿，却注意到妈妈可能被淋湿了。
[P3] 小熊姑娘长大后成为妈妈，带着小熊弟弟逛街遇雨，她撑伞时总是偏向孩子，保护他不被淋湿。
[P4] 小熊弟弟发现自己的身体和足球都没被淋湿，而妈妈却湿了半边身子，他感叹这是一把奇怪的小雨伞；妈妈回应说，她小时候妈妈也有一把这样的雨伞。
